class_root: Shared presentation owners do not distinguish an actionable exception or consent boundary from ordinary valid state.

prevention.invariant: Every declared shared presenter renders only actionable or consent-relevant explanations.
prevention.failure_mode: Issue-free storyboard returns no status banner; missing reference mode advice stays visible only with switchTo.
prevention.strategy: Remove redundant branches in their shared component owners, group shared host guidance once and retain each permission control.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove all-clear, no-reference-without-action and repeated teaching render branches; no alternate presentation path introduced.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Presentation-only change uses existing React/i18n components and no changed third-party behavior.

migration: No persisted state or permission migration.
